meta.about: The characters the player can be (docs/unreal/LOADOUT.md 3.4). The player is only ever seen as arms, so a crew member is a look on the same arms: skin, glove, sleeve, jewellery, built on SK_RuleArms and the UE5 mannequin skeleton (docs/unreal/CHARACTERS.md). Cosmetic only: no crew member changes a rule. Names, looks and lines of the three new members are placeholders for the user to replace; none is a real person's likeness.
meta.status: exists / inProgress / missing, as in guns.json
meta.phases: A look comes in two phases. `look` (phase 1) changes only material instances on Rule's arms and glove, so it needs no new mesh. `later` (phase 2) adds glove, sleeve and jewellery meshes. A member is offered when every asset of its `look` exists (Rule always: parity); its card uses `tagline` until every part of `later` exists, then `taglineFull`. Taglines describe only what is fitted.

slots.about: What a look may change. Every field is optional; a missing one keeps Rule's.
slots.arms: skeletal mesh of both arms on SK_Mannequin (default SK_RuleArms)
slots.materials: per material slot of the arms mesh: M_RuleArms_Skin, M_RuleArms_GloveLeather, M_RuleArms_GloveSuede, M_RuleArms_Rubber
slots.glove: a glove mesh variant replacing the glove surface (fingerless, cut-finger, none); null = Rule's glove
slots.sleeve: a sleeve mesh skinned to the upper arm and forearm (jacket cuff, hoodie, shirt); null = bare forearm
slots.jewellery: static meshes attached to a bone with a transform relative to it (CHARACTERS.md: the watch and bracelet)
slots.callName: the name the radio and the cards use; Rule keeps the original lines word for word

portrait.notes: a card of the arms and gloves on the showroom bench, never a face

arms.notes: SK_RuleArms built and proven in Unreal (CHARACTERS.md); being finished

jewellery.notes: watch and bracelet exist; the bracelet's offset comes from art/out/glb/SK_RuleArms.sockets.json (null here until copied)

deuce.brief: Goes in first. Phase 1: a skin tone clearly different from Rule's, black nylon work gloves. Phase 2: black fingerless knit gloves (fingers bare from the middle knuckle), a heather-grey hoodie sleeve pushed up to mid-forearm with a ribbed cuff, a thin gold rope bracelet on the right wrist.

MI_Crew_Skin_Deuce.notes: a material instance of M_RuleArms_Skin with its own tone and mottle seed; same UVs

MI_Crew_Glove_BlackNylon.notes: black nylon work glove on Rule's glove mesh: the leather and suede slots get one woven-nylon instance

glove.notes: a knit surface on Rule's glove pattern, fingers cut and hemmed; the bare fingertips use the skin material

sleeve.notes: a cloth tube on lowerarm and upperarm bones, weights transferred as for the arms (char.transfer_weights)

smoke.brief: Says nothing. Phase 1: grey suede gloves. Phase 2: bare hands with white athletic tape round the knuckles and the right wrist (needs the hand skin detail the glove hides today), a black nylon bomber cuff, a dark wooden bead bracelet on the left wrist.

MI_Crew_Glove_GreySuede.notes: grey suede all over Rule's glove: the leather slot takes the suede instance too

glove.notes: tape strips as a thin mesh over the knuckles and wrist, no glove

keys.brief: Knows every lock on the Ave. Phase 1: charcoal wool gloves. Phase 2: the thumb and index fingertips cut off the same gloves, a washed denim jacket cuff with a metal button, a black digital watch with an unbranded face where Rule wears his steel one.

MI_Crew_GloveWool.notes: charcoal wool knit on Rule's glove mesh

glove.notes: Rule's glove mesh with two fingertips opened; wool material instance on the leather and suede slots

jewellery.notes: same attach frame as Rule's watch

lines.about: Lines that name the player. A crew member with lines 'template' gets these, {name} = callName; Rule ('original') keeps text.json word for word.

camera: the Crew stage frames the arms from the first-person eye (frontend.json stage.cameras.arms), so the closed shoulder caps of SK_RuleArms are never seen (CHARACTERS.md, Proof in Unreal)
